Commits

  • build: regenerate dist, the skills copy and the stat figures for the load() review fixes
  • fix(graph-explorer): the outline filter reset selects through df$
  • test(e2e): graph-explorer-data covers every refusal, the first load, races, resets and the bounds
  • docs(graph-explorer): load()'s bounds, transfer on refusal, superseded loads; the probe's timings replace the UNKNOWN
  • fix(graph-explorer): a navigation during load() ends; load() clears search and outline filter; a superseded load() resolves false
  • fix(graph-explorer): a node's incoming links scan the sibling ranges in place
  • fix(graph-explorer): load() refuses holey name lists, SharedArrayBuffer arrays, clusters of more than 1,024 children and more than 256 levels
  • build: regenerate dist, the skills copy, What's new and the stat figures for load()
  • docs(graph-explorer): keep the transfer claim to what the e2e shows; the label copy cost is UNKNOWN
  • test(e2e): graph-explorer-data - a page's graph in the explorer
  • docs(graph-explorer): Your own graph - a code base loaded from the page
  • feat(graph-explorer): load() a page's graph (GraphExplorerData, data-source="external")
  • test(e2e): wait for lazily booted example previews (shared exampleFrame helper) and poll the Studio canvas after a WebKit drop - both flaked under load during the v0.9.18 release

  • feat(db-explorer): Database Explorer scaffold on defuss-db 3.1 (OPFS worker, Mongo-style queries, aggregations with date parts / zones / median / percentiles, history and timestamps with a revision Timeline per document, schema, indexes, export / import); Insert document with a highlighted JSON editor and a Property Tree mode; List view scrolls only its records, loads box-sized batches ahead in both directions, mounts trees on open; Table / JSON views windowed over every match; fix: a first-visit seed survives an interrupted or concurrent visit (Web Lock, a marker per collection); feat(api-docs): defuss-rpc 3.0 reference (Shiki examples, scrolling answers, centred RPC tag); fix(panel): a folded west panel reads bottom-up from the top - chevron, title, icon, tools; pins defuss-db 3.1.0, defuss-rpc 3.0.0, defuss-dataview 0.10.0

Commits

  • feat(chat): Component Schema + Chat Components + Chat Scripts - chats ask with cards (fields, currency, questionnaires with Other, plans, quick replies; typed answers, validation by JSON path, ui::component-schema fences and a show_components tool), scripted conversations without a model; AI Chat: Examples group (also for stores from earlier visits), cards in answers, the tool in API mode, script chats that follow their end, a light/dark Swap in the sidebar; fix(session): an appended row renders at its real size, a row removed under an anchored turn keeps the reader in place, scrollToEnd/Start end the anchor hold; questionnaire.test()
  • feat(ai-chat): attachments - images, audio, video, files and voice messages (paste, drop, MediaRecorder), media bubbles with a preview dialog, Audio/Video players, attachment cards, images to the API as image_url; fix(ai-chat): the store stopped saving after an attachment (undefined fields); fix(property-tree): an unchanged edit closes its editor; fix(docs): opaque site header - Chrome on macOS dropped the blurred header for a frame while scrolling over WebGL examples
  • feat(ai-chat): attachments - images, audio, video, files and voice messages (paste, drop, MediaRecorder), media bubbles with a preview dialog, Audio/Video players, attachment cards, images to the API as image_url; fix(ai-chat): the store stopped saving after an attachment (undefined fields); fix(property-tree): an unchanged edit closes its editor
  • feat(window-manager): one desktop across browser windows (data-share); fix(desktop): window menus hang from the menu bar, scaffold uses the look designs (white editor and fields, period calculator, menubar gap, lock screen power buttons, 7 folders without grey band), logon contrast, XP labels, 9x frames, 95 start menu
  • feat(window-manager): one desktop across browser windows (data-share) - BroadcastChannel, screen coordinates, a dragged window shows in and is taken by the browser window it is dropped on; fix(desktop): scaffold uses the look designs (white editor and fields, period calculator, menubar gap, lock screen power buttons, 7 folders without grey band), logon contrast, XP labels, 9x frames, 95 start menu
  • fix(desktop): logon contrast in 7 / XP (muted text, Turn off hover), XP Turn off larger at the right; XP folder labels without the wallpaper shadow; 95 / 98 windows with a thin frame and a sunken folder area; 95 start menu without the side strip; earlier: text-rotate any number of lines, shared cell editors, Data Grid / Data Tree inline editing, Property Tree, Notes, Desktop, Border Layout deep navigation
  • feat(workflow): labels kept clear of cards and each other, readable titles when zoomed out, palette data-workflow-types; Workflow Studio - Nodes panel, cards fit their content, app switch during a run, full-screen bundle styles
  • feat(calendar): Calendar scaffold - day / week / month / year views, settings for week start and calendar weeks, Find a time with a poll; Calendar shows ISO week numbers, never submits a form, and puts its day dots under the number
  • feat(data-grid): column menu (sort, lock, show/hide, reset), drag to move, edge to resize - mouse, keys and touch; kept with the view
  • feat(big-data): defuss-dataview 0.6 - locale sort kept, projection and aggregation examples for grids and trees
